metadata.sql: SELECT year, grand_prix, driver_name, constructor, position FROM v_race_results WHERE year = 2021 AND (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil') AND position = 1 LIMIT 1
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix?
